correctness.rationale: For positive gamma summing to one, the rank-one matrix Q=1 gamma^T satisfies Q^2=Q, yielding exact centered opinions Cx/(1+h). Enumerating the one empty forest, six one-arc forests and nine trees proves Z=(1+h)^2 and mixed-root total mass [1+h(1+gamma_3)]/Z. Therefore the single-draw polarization expectation and iid 1/T correction are exact for all positive real parameters. The centered U-statistic is unbiased by independence across distinct complete forest draws. Bounded-difference concentration uses a rigorously bounded kernel and a per-sample difference m/T. A standalone independent Fraction enumerator plus Gaussian solver passed 1230 rational assertions; the infinite-range proof is analytic.

value.rationale: The 2023 published social-hyperedge estimator is designed to compare contribution heterogeneity and opinion polarization. In the smallest genuine three-member hyperedge, the underlying polarization is independent of every contribution fraction, yet a finite forest sampling budget creates a false expected contribution response, and for any fixed budget its relative inflation grows without bound as group coupling increases. The exact law specifies an actionable budget and cross-forest correction, while honestly noting absolute bias vanishes at strong coupling and the general unbiasedness ingredient is classical. This motivated estimator limitation, tied to model interpretation, is not an arbitrary finite-count exercise.
